---
title: "Theorem and proof titles that hold Typst markup"
format: typst
language:
  crossref-thm-title: "Thm #y [*x*]"
  environment-proof-title: "Pf #y [*x*] \"q\""
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensurePdfRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'Thm #y \[\*x\*\] 1\. A theorem'
          - 'Pf #y \[\*x\*\] "q"\. An unnumbered proof'
        - []
---

Theorem and proof titles come from the language files, so an author can put
any text in them. The titles are written into the Typst frame definitions and
the unnumbered proof prefix, and must reach the page as written instead of
being read as Typst markup.

::: {#thm-a}

A theorem.

:::

::: {.proof}

An unnumbered proof.

:::
